sql.value: select e.id, e.template_id, t.name as template_name, e.template_version, e.model_id, e.model_name, e.ab_test_id, e.variant, e.input_variables, e.rendered_prompt, e.output, e.prompt_tokens, e.completion_tokens, e.total_tokens, e.cost, e.latency_ms, e.rating, e.feedback, e.create_by, e.create_time from ai_prompt_eval e left join ai_prompt_template t on t.id = e.template_id where 1=1 #[and e.template_id = :templateId] #[and e.ab_test_id = :abTestId] #[and e.variant = :variant] #[and e.rating = :rating] order by e.id desc
